text:
claire: Heads-up: Finance wants to simplify the free-tier experience. We're proposing a single monthly free bundle and a clearer overage flow. Enforcement date proposed: 2026-11-15. Short version below.

ben: Need the exact proposal so product can update Console copy.

claire: Proposal summary: single free bundle = 100k tokens/month (default). Advisory notifications at 50% and 90%. If an account exceeds 125% in a billing cycle we send an invoice estimate and apply a 48-hour cooling period before any hard throttle. Accounts with verified orgs (education/nonprofit) can request exemption.

oscar: API/SDK impact? Any header changes?

claire: Minimal: add optional headers `x-freebundle-remaining` and `x-invoice-estimate-id`. 429 semantics unchanged; advisory 429s include `x-advisory=true`. We'll also emit `billing_bundle_exhausted` events for telemetry.

ben: Support needs a one-click prepay link in the Console and a canned response for customers who hit the cooling period. Also want a debug panel showing `last_invoice_estimate`.

claire: Agreed. Marketing will craft transparent messaging about "clarity and fairness" (avoid "cuts"). We'll send a customer preview email two weeks before enforcement.

billing-bot: Reminder: invoice preview job scheduled 2026-11-16T03:00Z for accounts that cross 100% in the prior cycle.

oscar: I'll open infra tasks for header rollout, event emission, and a short migration to backfill `freebundle_expires` for legacy promos.

claire: Timeline: internal comms 2026-10-25 -> docs freeze 2026-11-01 -> enforcement 2026-11-15. Tagging owners: @ben (product), @oscar (engineering), @support for playbook.

ben: Thanks. I'll draft Console copy and share for review.
